Name: Prismatic Berry Crop
Author: iamtal
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds a new regrowable crop, the Prismatic Berry. This is a hardy crop that grows in all seasons. This crop follows the same growth schedule and fruit pricing as ancient seeds, and is intended to be a late game crop for those who do not want to deal with constantly needed to replant each season.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]In order to unlock this crop, the player must have completed either the Community Center or Joja, and have gained access to Ginger Island. Once the player has opened the Island Farm, Pierre will send a letter within a day or two letting you know he is now selling the new seeds.[/color][/size]

This mod is compatible with Generic Mod Config Menu if you would like to tinker with the pricing of the seeds or fruit.
